findings.finding: A one-MiB byte ceiling did not itself contain decoder recursion failure for deeply nested delta JSON.
findings.resolution: Existing semantic producer now converts RecursionError to OwnerSurgerySemanticError without rewriting exact delta evidence or creating a second parser owner.

findings.finding: Definitely-long exact diagnostic keys were JSON-escaped before inevitable digest collapse, allowing avoidable escape-expansion work inside a bounded diagnostic surface.
findings.resolution: Existing snapshot-custody organ now chooses whole-identity digest collapse before JSON escaping when source length already exceeds the segment ceiling.

findings.finding: The source-only accessibility fixture required non-color state wording that the specimen did not explicitly expose.
findings.resolution: Existing Warm Wall now explicitly states NON-COLOR STATE: SOURCE_WIRED and exposes the deep-JSON typed-stop state through native radio/touch semantics.
